sources.title: Introducing Laguna XS.2 and Laguna M.1 — April 28, 2026
sources.evidence: Dated public launch explicitly makes XS.2 weights available that day under Apache 2.0, alongside public API access. Identifies the XS.2 model separately from M.1. The later May 26 context-update banner is not the original release date.

sources.title: Laguna M.1/XS.2 Technical Report — May 25, 2026
sources.evidence: Sections 3.1 and 3.1.1 identify exact XS.2 as 33.4B total and 3B active, including embeddings. Describes a pre-norm Transformer MoE with top-8 of 256 experts plus a shared expert, first dense layer, sigmoid routing, mixed 3:1 sliding/global GQA and softplus per-head output gates. Pretraining used 4K, subsequent training reached 128K, and the final 256K extension doubled global RoPE scale without further training.

sources.title: Laguna XS.2 canonical BF16 model card, pinned revision
sources.evidence: Names the original XS.2 target; reports 33B/3B nominal, 40 layers, text-to-text, 262144 context, optional interleaved reasoning and native tool calls. Documents caller-supplied functions and separately optional DFlash draft. The card’s broad sigmoid-gating wording is disambiguated by the technical report and current implementation: attention output gates use softplus, while the MoE router uses sigmoid.

sources.title: Laguna XS.2 exact BF16 model configuration
sources.evidence: Selects LagunaForCausalLM, H=2048, V=100352, 40 layers, first dense width 8192 and 39 MoE layers with 256 routed experts/top-8, expert/shared width 512. Ten global layers have 48 query heads and thirty sliding layers 64; KV heads 8, head dimension 128. Untied embeddings, BF16 without quantization config, 262144 maximum positions; global YaRN factor 64 from 4096 positions and sliding window 512.

sources.title: Laguna XS.2 selected model implementation
sources.evidence: Reviewed enabled constructors and forward paths: untied embedding/head, both residual RMSNorms, QK RMSNorms, bias-free GQA and per-head softplus gates, dense SwiGLU, shared and routed expert MLPs, linear sigmoid router. Router correction vectors are nn.Parameters with requires_grad=False. Rotary frequency arrays are nonpersistent buffers. No vision encoder, SSM, attention sinks, MTP or draft module is instantiated. Current packed runtime expert matrices preserve the original separate checkpoint projection dimensions.

sources.title: Laguna XS.2 configuration defaults
sources.evidence: Defaults and exact JSON overrides determine all enabled layer, routing and attention branches. Confirms SiLU, untied embedding default and no additional parameterized branches beyond the reconstructed configuration.

sources.title: Laguna XS.2 complete checkpoint index and all 14 pinned shard headers
sources.evidence: Fetched only 8-byte lengths and bounded JSON headers for all 14 indexed BF16 shards. All 30513 names appear exactly once, with every shape reconciled to enabled config/code after equivalent split/packed expert naming. No missing, extra or mismatched tensors. Total 33442617088 storage elements equals index size 66885234176 bytes. Includes 9984 frozen router-correction values; excluding that routing state leaves 33442607104 learned-weight elements. Both untied vocabulary matrices, all norms, routing and attention gates, shared experts and routed experts are counted. No quantization scales, packed low-bit storage or persistent rotary buffers; no full weights downloaded.

sources.title: Laguna XS.2 model-materials license
sources.evidence: Actual weight repository contains the Apache License Version 2.0, matching the launch and card. This original XS.2 license is not the later XS 2.1 OpenMDW license.

sources.title: Laguna XS.2 native chat template
sources.evidence: Serializes text messages, function signatures, XML-like tool calls and tool responses, with preserved reasoning fields. enable_thinking defaults false in the template; a serving runtime can explicitly enable it. Confirms optional reasoning and custom tool-call support rather than an invariant default across deployments.

sources.title: Long context update: Laguna XS.2 and M.1 — May 26, 2026
sources.evidence: Dated announcement says XS.2 256K configuration is already available on Hugging Face and the hosted rollout will occur that day. Establishes that the expanded limit is a later update to the April release.

sources.title: Introducing Laguna XS 2.1 — July 2, 2026
sources.evidence: Explicitly identifies XS 2.1 as an upgrade of XS.2 and announces original XS.2 API sunset after one week, with dedicated deployment via Baseten remaining. This is a planned lifecycle statement, not verification of current endpoint availability; no XS 2.1 specifications are substituted.

name.note: Exact original variant and punctuation, distinct from Laguna XS 2.1.

developer.note: Official release and weight repository identify the developer.

release_date.note: Explicit first public API and open-weight launch, not May context extension or later code revision.

open_weights.note: Official downloadable post-trained checkpoint; complete indexed headers were publicly accessible.

license.note: Actual model-materials license. Does not inherit the differently licensed XS 2.1 successor.

parameters_b.note: Developer nominal total in decimal billions. More precise than card marketing label 33B, but not an exact 33400000000 count. Complete checkpoint reconciliation found 33442617088 BF16 stored values, including 9984 frozen routing-state values; remaining learned-weight count 33442607104 is consistent with the 33.4B nominal figure.

active_parameters_b.note: Official nominal activated-per-token count explicitly includes embeddings. Eight routed experts plus one shared expert participate in each of 39 sparse layers; the first layer is dense. A derived sum retaining both entire vocabulary matrices gives 3017125888 excluding frozen routing state, consistent with the rounded 3B; it is not presented as a separately declared exact active convention.

architecture.note: Decoder-only pre-norm Transformer MoE with 40 layers: first dense and 39 sparse; top-8 of 256 routed experts plus one shared, 30 sliding and 10 global GQA layers. Current code and report use softplus attention gates and sigmoid routing; this distinguishes the two gates behind the card’s broad sigmoid-gating wording.

context_window.note: Released extended-context limit after May 26 update, not native unscaled 256K training. Global attention uses YaRN factor 64 from 4096 positions; the report describes context training through 128K and a final extension without further training.

modalities.note: Text/code input and text output. External tools and images used by an application do not add native model modalities.

reasoning.note: Optional interleaved thinking and preserved reasoning; template defaults false unless explicitly enabled by caller/server. Capability is verified independently of deployment default.

tool_call.note: Exact native template and card provide caller-defined function signatures, tool-call outputs and responses. The caller executes tools.

description.value: Poolside text model for agentic coding, with open weights, optional reasoning and tool calling.
description.note: Uses supported capabilities without a generic local-hardware guarantee or benchmark claims.

patch.notes: Parameters are Poolside’s nominal 33.4B total and 3B active per token, including embeddings. At BF16 revision a397bde04501591d0ac3d74a5d9d0a4ec298ffb8, all 14 shard headers reconcile to 33,442,617,088 stored values; excluding 9,984 frozen routing-correction values leaves 33,442,607,104 learned-weight elements. Both untied vocabulary matrices are included; the optional separate DFlash draft is excluded. The 262,144-token limit was released in May 2026 using YaRN after training through 128K; it is not native 256K training. Reasoning is optional and the template defaults it off unless enabled. The July 2 successor announcement scheduled this original model’s API sunset after one week; open weights remain available.

checkpoint_audit.module_mapping: Header experts contain separate gate/up/down matrices; current runtime packs gate/up and experts without changing element counts. Header shared_expert maps to runtime shared_experts, correction vectors from experts to gate.

summary: Audited all 14 fields. Added Apache-2.0, nominal 33.4B total/3B active and MoE architecture; confirmed April 28 release, text modalities, optional reasoning/tools and later 262144 context update. Reconciled every indexed tensor shape across all 14 BF16 shard headers, separating frozen routing state and external speculative draft. Preserved the original XS.2 identity, license and chronology rather than transferring XS 2.1 specifications.
